sentences.en: The sheriff beat the suspect until he was almost dead.
sentences.zh: 治安官把嫌疑人打得差点死了。

sentences.en: The sheriff doesn't want me to work on cases anymore.
sentences.zh: 治安官不想让我再接手案件了。

sentences.en: Sheriff Wyatt Earp talked to that old trapper yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天治安官瓦伊特·厄普和那个老猎人谈过话。
